title: hotfix: slo-enforcer backoff tuning to prevent regional thrashing under load
author: Anya Patel
description:
Background: During a recent traffic spike we observed regional thrashing where multiple regions simultaneously entered aggressive backoff and load-shedding. This caused cascading capacity loss and customer-visible errors. Root cause: the SLO enforcer backoff growth factor + synchronized retry windows allowed regions to re-enter traffic simultaneously.

This hotfix introduces conservative backoff growth, randomized jitter, and a small per-region token-bucket gate to smooth recovery. The change reduces the maximum backoff multiplier from 8x to 4x for transient enforcement, adds exponential backoff cap with randomized jitter (±10%), and introduces a per-region recovery-rate limiter to prevent synchronized ramp-ups. Additionally: updated load-shedding thresholds to prefer graceful degradation (queue rejection at earlier stages), added metrics (slo_enforcer.backoff_multiplier, slo_enforcer.region_recovery_tokens, slo_enforcer.load_shed_decision_reason), and included a feature flag (slo_enforcer:regional-backoff-stabilizer) to allow immediate rollback if needed.

Checklist: - [x] Implement conservative backoff and jitter - [x] Add per-region token-bucket gate - [x] Add unit + integration tests for backoff math and gating - [x] Add metrics and tags for visibility - [x] Update runbook and ops playbook - [x] Feature-flagged rollout and monitoring plan

Rollout plan: roll out to Canary (us-west-2) for 1 hour, monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_multiplier.percentiles and slo_error_rate; then 25% of regional capacity for 6 hours; full rollout if signals stable. If error rate increases by >0.5% absolute or latency P95 regressions >100ms, rollback via feature flag.

review_conversation: Maya Singh (reviewer) - 2026-02-20: Requested changes: Please add deterministic unit tests for the jitter behavior (use seeded RNG) and document the exact metric tag set so dashboards don't break. Also, confirm the default feature flag is OFF.
Anya Patel (author) - 2026-02-20: Reply: Added seeded RNG unit tests in backoff_test.go and updated metrics YAML with tags. Feature flag default set to false. PTAL.

Jordan Park (reviewer) - 2026-02-21: Comment: Can we reduce the default max multiplier to 3x for Canary given customer sensitivity? Concerned about under-serving. Suggest we instead increase recovery token refill slightly.
Anya Patel (author) - 2026-02-21: Reply: Accepted compromise: set default to 4x but bump region recovery token refill rate by +25% for Canary via feature-flag override. Added note to rollout plan.
Carlos Ruiz (reviewer) - 2026-02-21: Approval: Approving with follow-up to add auditing on backoff state transitions so postmortems can reconstruct sequences.
Jordan Park (reviewer) - 2026-02-22: Approval: Changes look good and tested in staging. CI green after re-run.
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent synchronized regional thrashing. Adds jitter, per-region recovery gating, metric visibility, and a feature flag for controlled rollout.
